question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Recalcitrance**
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Compliance .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Recalcitrance** refers to defiance, resistance, or a rebellious attitude towards authority.
 
• The antonym of **Recalcitrance** is a word that signifies submission, obedience, or agreement.
 
• Among the given options:
 
 
• **Defiance** (Option 1) is synonymous with Recalcitrance.
 
• **Compliance** (Option 2) means agreeing or conforming to rules or authority, which is the opposite of Recalcitrance.
 
• **Resistance** (Option 3) is similar to Recalcitrance as it implies opposition.
 
• **Rebellion** (Option 4) also aligns with Recalcitrance as it suggests opposition to authority.
 
 

Correct explanation: The word **Compliance** (Option 2) is the most appropriate antonym for **Recalcitrance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Synonyms of Recalcitrance:**
 
 
• Defiance
 
• Resistance
 
• Rebellion
 
 
 
• **Antonyms of Recalcitrance:**
 
 
• Compliance
 
• Obedience
 
• Submission
